status: prospective; candidate predictions and timings have not run
scope: Separate synthetic decoder implementation experiment. The production math decoder and frozen fourteen-case source-reference gate are unchanged. No arbitrary-age row insertion or multilingual quality conclusion.

reference.source_binding: Before accepting results retain protocol commit, exact source commit, binary hash, Cargo.lock, native lock/artifact hashes, model manifest, immutable container identity, CPU model/affinity and cgroup settings. Retain every started attempt and failure.

settings.threads: equal to CPU profile, one or two
settings.opencv_threads: equal to CPU profile, one or two
settings.early_stop: unchanged: after at least eight probabilities, mean below 0.8

implementation.mapping: Fixed [usize;64] stable live-to-original cohort-row map; scalar position remains the common original step.
implementation.gather: Safe forward in-place CPU copies in already-owned ORT outputs; layer-major caches use logical old batch, never the physical pre-compaction shape. Prefix TensorRef inputs expose the new logical shape. No extra cache arena.
implementation.verification_scope: A const-generic switch shares the copy implementation: true verifies every moved source/destination block in the gate; false omits diagnostic reads/comparisons in timed runs and reports zero verified elements.
implementation.gathered_bytes: Count actual nonidentity copy_within blocks times element size, separately for both cross caches, both self caches, mask and tokens. Also count compared gather elements and native decoder row-steps.
implementation.allocation_scope: The fixed-array gather/control core must allocate zero Rust heap bytes. ORT output allocation, TensorRef/OrtValue/Arc metadata, diagnostics, input preparation and session setup are separate; do not call the complete decoder allocation-free. Count constructed input views, not assumed native allocation counts.

gates.production_reference: Generate ordinary trace with the unchanged Engine::recognize path; independently replay its exact math input/widths. Require baseline encoder memory, mask, cross caches, logits, token and done snapshots to match the production trace before accepting candidate results.
gates.mapped_native: At every original scalar step compare each live original row's mask, cross caches, self-cache inputs/outputs, logits, selected token, stop decision/reason/step, complete token history, probabilities and decoded UTF-8 against the ordinary replay. Compare gathered source/destination bits immediately and use independent sentinel oracle tests to validate strides.
gates.discrete: Tokens, stop bits/reasons/steps, original-row mapping and decoded UTF-8 exact, including the actual production final accepted UTF-8 snapshots per original row. Every original row completes exactly once. Never relax tolerance or discard a failed profile.
gates.synthetic_scope: The required fixture must actually execute 6 -> 4 -> 3 -> 2 -> 1 live rows; absence of a shrink is a failed test, not compaction evidence.
gates.regression: Existing frozen fourteen-case source-reference gate remains independently required for the newly linked default engine.

paired_measurement.arm_order: Even repetition ordinary then compact; odd repetition compact then ordinary.
paired_measurement.warmup: Verify models, warm all four math sessions and run the selected arm once before timing; immutable files and filesystem cache are warm.
paired_measurement.timed_scope: Encoder + init + complete decoder cohort including all gather and input-view construction costs; immediate bit verification is enabled only in the numerical gate and compiled out of timing. Decoder-only time reported separately. Production page preprocessing and Tika are excluded and cannot be claimed improved.
paired_measurement.interpretation: Descriptive paired raw differences and ratios at the repetition level. A synthetic cohort does not establish production latency or quality. Report parity failure as rejection with original evidence; report a slower candidate without hiding copy costs. No promotion to production in this experiment.
